summary.text: Alex Corrigan is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Nate Gustafson.
She is a member of the Neenah Joint School District Board of Education, a position she assumed in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Corrigan's campaign website says she chose to put down roots in the 55th District, raised four children there and serves on the school board.
It lists strengthening community, managing increasing costs and uplifting education as her focus areas.
Ballotpedia lists her current school board term as ending in 2027.
